session_summary: Title bar: 'Bull Trending TR Day, But Reversed Down'. A triangle opening range sets a double bottom higher low major trend reversal at 3316; the market trends up in green shaded legs with a bull spike to 3330 before bears break out below the upper trading range at 10:30, a wedge low retest of 3316 at 11:00, and a rally to 3325 reverses back down after a third sell setup near the close.
